subject: general
question:
The given sentence has an error. Select the option that rectifies the error.

The students were asked to turn up their assignments by Friday.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. turn in their assignments .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"turn up"** in the sentence is incorrect and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• The appropriate phrasal verb is **"turn in"**, which means to submit or hand over something (like assignments).
 
• The corrected sentence reads: **"The students were asked to turn in their assignments by Friday."**

Correct sentence: *The students were asked to turn in their assignments by Friday.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonly confused phrasal verbs:**

 
 
• **Turn up:** To appear or arrive unexpectedly or to increase the volume/intensity.
 
• **Turn in:** To submit something or to go to bed.
 
• **Turn out:** To result in a particular way or to attend an event.
 
 
 
• Understanding context is crucial to choosing the correct phrasal verb.
